# MakeUseOf

> MakeUseOf is a technology guide and review site that simplifies complex tech topics through practical how-to articles, product reviews, and optimization tips.

MakeUseOf covers a broad spectrum of consumer technology including smartphones, computers, streaming services, smart home devices, and emerging tech trends. The site focuses on practical advice, personal experiences, and step-by-step guides to help readers maximize their technology investments.

## Key Topics

- Android optimization
- Windows 11
- Streaming services
- Smart home
- AI automation
- Cloud storage
- Gaming hardware
- Browser recommendations
- Smartphone tips
- Tech reviews
- Hardware guides
- Cord-cutting
- Bluetooth technology
- Device performance
- Satellite internet

## Device Optimization & Performance

- [My Pixel was slowing down until I changed these settings — it felt like a new phone immediately](https://www.makeuseof.com/pixel-slowing-until-changed-settings-felt-like-new-phone-immediately): Google Pixel optimization guide for improving phone performance.
- [These Android sync settings are wasting battery and data on things you'll never use](https://www.makeuseof.com/android-sync-settings-wasting-battery-data-on-things-youll-never-use): Android optimization tips for reducing battery drain from sync settings.
- [I fixed the worst part of Windows updates with a registry key — and I haven't lost work since](https://www.makeuseof.com/i-fixed-worst-part-windows-updates-registry-key): Windows registry tweak to prevent forced restarts after updates.
- [I replaced my bloated Windows toolkit with these 7 lightweight utilities — I should have done it years ago](https://www.makeuseof.com/replaced-bloated-windows-toolkit-lightweight-utilities-done-years-ago): Guide to lightweight Windows utilities and PowerToys alternatives.
- [Your USB hub is probably lying to you about its speed — here's how to catch it](https://www.makeuseof.com/your-usb-hub-probably-lying-about-its-speed-how-to-catch-it): Guide to testing USB hub speeds and verifying manufacturer claims.

## Streaming & Media Solutions

- [12 Free Movie Streaming Sites With No Sign Up Requirements](https://www.makeuseof.com/free-movie-streaming-sites-no-sign-up): Guide to legal free streaming alternatives to Netflix and Disney+.
- [One Raspberry Pi was all I needed to turn my Samsung TV into a streaming powerhouse](https://www.makeuseof.com/turn-old-tv-into-streaming-powerhouse-raspberry-pi): DIY guide to converting old Samsung TV into Raspberry Pi media center.
- [I turned my scattered free cloud storage into one big drive with rclone](https://www.makeuseof.com/i-turned-my-scattered-free-cloud-storage-into-one-big-drive-with-rclone): Tutorial on using rclone to consolidate multiple cloud storage accounts.
